_original_lore: Thorn is the boss of Floor 4 of the Catacombs. He is a
'Shaman Necromancer', appears as a ghast, and does not
attack the player. He spawns Spirit Animals that you must
kill to spawn a Spirit Bear which when killed drops the Spirit
Bow which is a single shot bow and the only way to damage him.
name: 荆棘 (首领)

source: Thorn is the boss of Floor {{N0}} of the Catacombs. He is a

loreParagraphs.translation: 索恩是地牢第 {{N0}} 层的首领.他是一名 '萨满死灵法师',以恶魂形态出现,不会攻击玩家.他会生成灵魂动物,你必须击杀它们来生成灵魂熊,击杀灵魂熊后会掉落灵魂之弓,这是一把单发弓,也是唯一能伤害他的方式.
